“你瞎说什么呢？”

苏行舟都感觉羞耻，连忙打断她的话。

“那你刚才叫谁妈？不是我难道是浩纯啊....唔~”

苏行舟连忙捂住了她的嘴，威胁道：

“李雪，你再调戏我，我就把你投尸荒野，反正这里是废弃厂房。”

李雪看到苏行舟急眼，心中恶趣味更浓。

还是年下好玩，随便逗。

而且苏行舟还是高质量年下，既有年下的青涩，又有年上的事业才华。

恢复联系这两周来，她已经从相处着试试看到垂涎欲滴了。

李雪知道逗得差不多了，她眨了眨眼，用灵巧的小舌头在苏行舟的手心舔了一下。

苏行舟感受到手里湿润润的，身子跟着一激灵。

要说觉得恶心那是不可能的。

因为李雪此刻一对狐狸眼好似若有若无的放电，她的长相又纯又欲，看不出她是故意的还是不小心的。

这样一副狐狸妖妃模样的美人偷偷舔舐你的手心，自然是跟着意动，而不是觉得恶心。

可惜，舔的是手心。

要是手指，或者大苏的话.....

“流氓！”

没等苏行舟往深里想，李雪就挣脱开来轻锤了他一下。

李雪抹了抹嘴巴，她一看就知道苏行舟在想些不健康的东西，脸上表情有些不对。

“唉，女人啊。”苏行舟摇摇头：“到底是要我流氓还是不流氓？”

这几天工作太忙，两人关系推进停滞，他能看出今天李雪是忍不住主动出击了。

“而且，是你舔我的吧？”

“闭嘴~”

李雪红着脸，整理乱了的头发。

都怪苏行舟这个小坏蛋，和他相处起来每天都被勾得心乱乱的。

若即若离，时坏时好，让人捉摸不透他在想什么。

李雪不知道在后世这叫，海王。

“雪姐。”苏行舟从后面揽着她的，感受她瘦了之后恰到好处的腰肢：“我真的不懂什么时候该流氓，需要你带带我，行吗？”

李雪脸色红润。

瞬间get到苏行舟什么意思。

她正想继续说话，听到不远处的五百突然喊卡。

“咔！”

“刘浩纯杀青！”

"What are you talking nonsense about?"

Su Xingzhou felt ashamed and quickly interrupted her.

"Then whose mother did you just call? If it wasn't me, could it be Haochun... Hmm~"

Su Xingzhou quickly covered her mouth and threatened:

"Li Xue, if you tease me again, I will throw your body into the wilderness. This is an abandoned factory anyway."

Seeing Su Xingzhou's anxious expression, Li Xue felt even more malicious.

It’s still fun at the end of the year, just be funny.

Moreover, Su Xingzhou is still a high-quality junior, with both the youthfulness of his junior and the career talent of his senior.

In the past two weeks since we resumed contact, she has been salivating from trying to get along with him.

Li Xue knew that she was done teasing her. She blinked and licked Su Xingzhou's palm with her nimble little tongue.

Su Xingzhou felt the moisture in his hands, and his body trembled.

It is impossible to say that I feel disgusted.

Because Li Xue's fox eyes seemed to be sparkling with electricity at the moment, and her appearance was pure and lustful. It was hard to tell whether she was doing it on purpose or accidentally.

Such a beauty who looks like a fox concubine secretly licks the palm of your hand. Naturally, she follows your intention and does not feel disgusted.

Unfortunately, it was the palm of my hand that I licked.

If it's a finger or a big su...

"Rogue!"

Before Su Xingzhou could think deeply, Li Xue broke away and gave him a light hammer.

Li Xue wiped her mouth. She knew at a glance that Su Xingzhou was thinking about something unhealthy, and there was something wrong with the expression on his face.

"Oh, woman." Su Xingzhou shook his head: "Do you want me to be a rogue or not?"

Work has been too busy these days, and the relationship between the two has stalled. He can see that Li Xue couldn't help but take the initiative today.

"Besides, you licked me, right?"

"Shut up~"

Li Xue blushed and tidied her messed up hair.

It's all because of Su Xingzhou, this little scoundrel, I get distracted every day when I get along with him.

He seems to be far away, sometimes bad and sometimes good, making it difficult for people to figure out what he is thinking.

Li Xue didn't know that in later generations this would be called Neptune.

"Sister Xue." Su Xingzhou hugged her from behind and felt her waist that was just right after losing weight: "I really don't know when to be a gangster. I need you to take care of me, okay?"

Li Xue's face was rosy.

I instantly understood what Su Xingzhou meant.

She was about to continue talking when she heard Wubai not far away suddenly shouting "Ka".

"Click!"

"Liu Haochun is finished!"
